why: Drops the exemption that makes the sideways reading usable at all. A visible-overflow box reports content painting outside its padding box without scrolling anywhere: measured on a clean tree, 168 such readings across 12 element classes, nearly all buttons whose label is wider than the box its text is centred in. Without this line the gate fails a clean tree on 168 non-defects, which is a check nobody can keep.
killedBy: menu hit-target verdict (issue #686) passes the two reported shapes that are wider than their box and are not defects
